name: North Wind's Night Verse
text:
This +1 striking frost katana is always cool to the touch, nearly uncomfortably so. Unadorned and with no tsuba, its honed blade is carved from a single tusk of dragon-turtle ivory and wrapped in strips of witchwarg hide. Strikes with the katana gain a +2 status bonus to damage rolls against creatures that have a status penalty to their Speed or that are slowed. The status bonus increases to +3 if the weapon has a greater striking rune and +4 for a major striking rune.

Activate—Frigid Breeze f (air, cold, magical, manipulate)

Frequency once per minute

Trigger You deal cold damage to a creature with a spell or ability

---
Effect You point the north wind's night verse at the triggering creature. A gust of wind from nowhere freezes its bones, imparting a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.
